### Session 790a8f50-9040-4fa2-8a17-a3a93618190b - 2026-09-18T14:29:55.778Z

- User received findings from a peer Claude session investigating Jobber's job/visit assignment structure and mechanism for owner drift in future windows.
- Peer session ("born-wrong") introspected Jobber schema: `Job.visitSchedule.assignedTo` holds job-level default (writable via `jobEdit`); `Visit.assignedUsers` holds individual visit tech; both can diverge from territory owner.
- Peer analyzed 40 jobs with visits in untouched October 2026 window and found **65% (26 of 40) carry tech mismatching territory owner**; 18 jobs show three-way disagreement (visit tech ≠ job default ≠ territory owner); 15 job defaults are blank.
- **Root mechanism identified:** Jobber mints entire recurring series at job creation (Jan–Apr 2026, one year forward), each visit stamped with job default as of creation date. Scripts rewrite only a ~3-week rolling horizon, leaving everything beyond frozen. Not drift accumulation — bulk-created stale assignments.
- Five rewritten jobs examined: all show clean pattern of older visits (post-Sep-25 window) rewritten to current tech, but outer recurrence series (through 2027) still hold original Jan–Apr assignees.
- User summarized findings and noted two remaining probes needed: **adherence** (do scripts execute consistently on the horizon?) and **volume** (scale of impact across all jobs).

### Session dd912eca-e458-4c44-be47-15d360f9e9a6 - 2026-09-18T15:00:09.797Z

- User asked what steps are needed to create a master route system that functions like major route-based companies (Rollins, UPS, Terminix).
- Claude Code diagnosed the core issue: a master route is a permanent list of customer-to-route-day assignments (tech + weekday), held on the job record, not in files or scripts — the solver sequences within the route-day only.
- Identified capacity constraint as a prerequisite: ~278 hours of demand against 200 available hours weekly; capacity decision (hire, soften cadence rules, or accept 9–10 hour days) must be made first before any master route design works.
- Proposed a 10-step framework: build from 60 days of actual completed visits (90% already consistent); adjudicate residual edge cases once; store route-day on the Jobber job as a custom field; rewrite recurring series once to match; make intake the only assignment point; reduce cadence engine to weekly-vs-monthly gate only; lock OptimoRoute per route-day with balancing off; monthly rebalancing by real hours per tech; delete n8n and competing writers.
- Offered a 4-week phased timeline: Week 1 capacity + as-built master; Week 2 adjudication + Jobber field; Week 3 series rewrite + intake rule live; Week 4 cadence gating + monthly review.
- Key structural change: move route-day from `territories.json` and scattered scripts into a Jobber custom field so the master travels with the customer record and drift from competing writes stops.
- Offered to publish the framework as a handoff document for Cory.

- Offered to run the 25 route-day drive table analysis immediately if approved, showing week-to-week variance from actual completion data
